admission.justification: Retired starter and copy commands survived in the setup skill, a sandbox expectation module and the settings reference at once, so the removal is durable only where all three agree.

applicability: Startup and install guidance that a user or sandbox runner follows to reach a working seat.
conditions: The guidance names the one-call path and the package-served skills.
Sandbox and runtime helpers obtain their expectations from the live settings and host surface rather than a copied skill tree.
exclusions: Captured historical evidence, which is not rewritten to describe the new build.

evidence: a2/distribution-review.md F2; a2/doctrine-review.md P2; final-a3/removal-hits.json executable hits, including docs/install/{claude-code,codex,cursor,antigravity,hermes,openclaw,pi,vscode-copilot}.md and generated hooks/renderers; a3/routes/07-distribution-removal.md.

statement: Current startup instructions and sandbox/runtime dependencies use the one-call package-served path, not retired harness copies or their generators.
